programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a student film, but they all have a different movie in mind; The Chipmunks follow Dave and fear that he's fallen in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a wax statue!

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin is accused of revealing spoilers for everyone's favourite TV show, he agrees not to speak for 24 hours. When Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they go all out to replace it before he notices.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore is stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats during a week that Dave wants the boys to focus only on school. The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: The Road Warrior / My Fair Chipette
programme.desc: Alvin sounds the alarm when he believes Theodore has joined a motorcycle gang of vampires; When Brittany declines Alvin's help for a talent show, he convinces Jeanette to enter, putting them at odds.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: After Brittany and the girls release a video that goes viral, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore try to top it. Simon falls ill and asks Alvin and Theodore not to go see a new movie without him, but Alvin just cannot resist.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: He Said She Said; Attack of the Zombies
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off at the school to Miss Smith. Convinced a zombie invasion is imminent, Alvin and Theodore go all out in an attempt to protect their loved ones.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When pirates show up at the house, the boys do all they can to protect a treasure chest that arrived for Dave. The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new talking teddy bear drives Alvin and Simon crazy. Alvin is not thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new principal.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: The Exchange Student; Crystal Ball Birthday
programme.desc: When an exchange student comes to visit, he tells a scary story that makes the chipmunks think Dave is in danger. Annie and Amber offer to plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor in the process.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: While cleaning out their treehouse, the girls reminisce about how they saved the tree from being cut down; Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to boarding school.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: A Room of One's Own; Carts and Crafts
programme.desc: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room; after Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bike, he enters the boys in a round up of shopping carts where the first prize is a new bike.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting is not easy when they have to care for a robot baby for a school assignment. When Alvin's football team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help with their conditioning.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but have to keep the puppy hidden from Dave, who won't allow pets. Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest against a skate park bully even though she has no clue how to ride; complaints rise as Simon's robot Gizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: The C Team; Father Daughter Dance
programme.desc: Coach Dobbins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game. Dave has a problem when each of the Chipettes wants him to be their date to the Father Daughter Dance.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon's interactive video game is about to take off, until Jeanette reprograms the game's villain; when Alvin dreams of joining a private club, he volunteers Dave to play squash, even though Dave doesn't play.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin talks Dave into buying a used tour bus, Dave has no idea of the problems ahead. Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin bets Bo Carter that alien life exists and only has a week to prove it or suffer embarrassing consequences. Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog and vows to get him back.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Brittany the Body Snatcher; Agent Smith
programme.desc: When Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him, he's sure an alien has taken over her body. In order to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story the school's ever seen.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette signs the Chipmunks and the Chipettes up for a green living competition; Alvin agrees to look after his crush's talking bird.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Lost in Space ... Camp; Super Hot Chocolate
programme.desc: Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff when the Chipmunks and Chipettes head off to space camp. Theodore burns his tongue on some super-hot chocolate and loses his sense of taste.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany is preparing a class speech on inner beauty when she gets a rash on her face. Can she practice what she preaches? Alvin thinks that Kevin has a secret crush on one of the Chipettes. When the girls find out, they try to let Kevin down gently.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: The Curse Of Macbeth / Zeela The Great
programme.desc: The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play, after learning of its curse; Simon's robot Gizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela, until a sudden tragedy reveals Gizmo's true heart.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Brittany is hurt before a major school event, Jeanette fills in as the Principal's assistant. When Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, Alvin enlists Dave's help, locking the families in a heated competition.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Eleanor discovers there are no female knights, she hides in a suit of armour and enters a knight competition; Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol, but her idol only likes her art after Alvin ruins it; Alvin is convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in to their home, so he tries to stop the invasion.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette and the Chipmunks orchestrate a break-in at Bocarter's house to rescue a chimpanzee he keeps in a cage. Alvin is alarmed that Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes because he's not that funny.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin tries to get out of the annual family-day picnic with Dave because he has tickets to the big football match.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When an accident forces Simon to wear his embarrassing old glasses, he becomes the target of the school bully. So Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard to stand up to the bullies.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: In order to get Theodore to do his bidding, Alvin tells Theodore that he has secret powers and can turn rubbish into sweeties.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: I Will Survive; Alvin's Got a Brand New Bag
programme.desc: When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: After a fight with Brittany, Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers. Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a big hit.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, Alvin goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend. Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.

programme.sub-title: The Great Chipmunk Detective; Guitar Hero
